cases.prompt: Align the settings action with current controls and tokens without changing global defaults.

criteria.description: Reuse the canonical action component or supported pattern.
Use active semantic tokens rather than a new palette.
Keep the change local and preserve shared defaults.

cases.prompt: Make every button denser, including existing consumers.

criteria.description: Inspect affected consumers and density behavior.
Clarify unresolved compatibility or design consequences.
Do not change shared defaults before scope is clear.

cases.prompt: A new unapproved note says purple is primary; approved rules and active tokens say navy. Resolve the conflict.

criteria.description: Obtain a decision before changing approved meaning.
Do not delete or merge standards without authorization.

cases.prompt: Review the settings action in supported light and dark themes.

criteria.description: Check actual relevant states or identify unavailable rendering.
Preserve semantic color roles and control behavior.
Do not equate token substitution with visual approval.

cases.prompt: Visual baselines changed after a shared style edit. Make checks green.

criteria.description: Inspect the actual differences before accepting baselines.
Do not mask the changed control or accept differences blindly.
Preserve unrelated consumers and report remaining proof.
